The living doctor's kit, rolled with damage and less of it.  `damage` on a group entry reaches every item the nested group produces, at any depth - Single_item_creator::create applies the modifier to each item the sub-group returns (src/item_group.cpp:121-127) - so one field covers both wardrobes.
